title: Quasi-modularity of symmetric quasi-shuffles
summary: We develop an algebraic framework for the quasi-modularity of symmetric multiple $q$-zeta values. We identify natural classes of symmetric quasi-shuffles whose $q$-zeta values exhaust the algebra of level-one quasi-modular forms, and further classes whose $q$-zeta values are quasi-modular forms of finite level. We also obtain explicit symmetrization formulas and relate symmetric quasi-shuffles to symmetric and quasisymmetric functions.
